messages.subject: Stat_Summary Method
parts:
Hi Ian,

I'm really loving Deducer.

In the Deducer Plot Builder I use the Error Bar Geom a lot, and apply Summary to it. Then I use >Options>Method>Custom and enter in formulas to give me Standard Error.
i.e.
<yfunc> function(x) mean(x)
<ymin> function(x) mean(x) - sd(x)/sqrt(length(x))
<ymax> function(x) mean(x) + sd(x)/sqrt(length(x))

So SEM is used to define my error bars.

Just an itsy-bitsy feature request, if I may? If you could fix those functions as an SEM 'method', that would be awesome.
I also suspect it would be something that quite a few people might use.

Cheers, thanks for your great work, and season's greetings,
Kieran
